Name: GPARAM_REF_SETTINGS_PARAM_ST
Description: Lets a legacy map use another map's GPARAM (lighting and weather graphics) files. The row ID is the map's area and block as a number (m30_01 → 30010000); the rest of the map ID is ignored. Retail rows are all legacy maps: every catacomb uses m30_00's files, and several DLC maps share files the same way.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail: off on every row).

Fields.Name: GPARAM Source Map ID
Fields.Description: Map whose GPARAM files are loaded instead of the map's own, as a number (m30_00 → 30000000). Only the area and block are used. A target in the overworld (m60 and others) makes the map use overworld GPARAM handling. -1: the map's own files.
